access_method: Official REST API for issues in public repositories only; HTML scraping is excluded.
authentication: Optional token supplied through an environment variable; never persisted or shared to bypass rate limits.
rate_limit: Observe response headers; current primary limits are 60 requests/hour without authentication and 5,000 requests/hour for a typical authenticated user.
allowed_usage: Internal demand research and derived analysis of public repository issues only; no spam, user contact, personal-information sale, or private repository access.
raw_text_retention: Normalized public issue text is retained local-only for the experiment; raw author identifiers, profile data, authentication data, and full API payloads are not retained.
redistribution: Derived metrics, source URLs, timestamps, and content fingerprints only; issue bodies and raw personal data are not redistributed.
deletion_handling: Remove locally retained text when an item disappears during refresh or upon a valid removal request; retain only non-reversible aggregate metrics when appropriate.
attribution: The original GitHub source URL is retained for every observation.
robots_or_automated_access_policy: Official REST API only; respect primary and secondary rate limits and do not scrape GitHub HTML.
